A '''battle''' at [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]] final battle between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the forces of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Sander Delvardus]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5.5 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

After the unsuccessful [[Battle of Sullust (Delvardus campaign)|attack]] of Delvardus on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], the New Republic led by the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Sien Sovv]] launched a counterattack campaign for the control of territories of the [[Eriadu Authority]].<ref name="TEA" />

The battle was described as a "merciless assault".<ref name="TEA" />

After this battle, Delvardus abandoned the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] and fled in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="TEA" />
